note: Real-ELF ProgramTest for the fractional claim-check life: open the native escrow, compact a sleeping holder's reserve, redeem shards, close. Committed and passing since 8fdcdc56 and INVISIBLE to the census until 2026-09-01, because the workspace took no dclutch-program-test-evidence dependency and so called record() for nothing. Campaign: programs/dclutch-claims-sbf/program-test/fractional-atomic (tests/fractional_compaction.rs). EVERY BINDING BELOW WAS AUTHORED FROM FOLDED EVIDENCE, NEVER FROM WHAT THE CAMPAIGN OUGHT TO TOUCH: the labels, the outcomes, the invoked programs and the refusal codes are the ones the runtime reported in a 47-transaction fold, and each label was checked to carry exactly one outcome AND one refusal code before it was written down. The first draft failed that check and `census observe` is what caught it: six hostile crank substitutions shared a label, and five of them raise codes the binding did not name. The label now carries the plant, which is the discriminator the campaign itself varies. That order matters -- docs/reference/routes.md derives `witnessed` from bindings alone and never consults the ledger, so a binding written from expectation manufactures the false green this tier exists to remove.

bindings.label: fractional claim-check: open the native claim-check escrow
bindings.note: DCLTCCO1. A stranger opens the escrow and prepays it; observed 11 times across the campaign, always accepted, invoking Claims and the System program only. This is the route's first census evidence of any kind.

bindings.label: fractional claim-check: close the settled native escrow
bindings.note: DCLTCCR1 / CloseEscrow. The settled escrow closes and its rent returns to the cranker; observed twice, accepted, Claims plus Token-2022.

bindings.label: fractional claim-check: a premature escrow close refuses on the vault
bindings.note: HOSTILE. The same route refusing: a close attempted while the vault is still funded. Observed twice as Custom(0x5625), Claims alone in the frame.

bindings.label: fractional claim-check: a stranger compacts a sleeping holder reserve
bindings.note: DCLTFCC1, driven through the test caller. Observed 3 times, accepted, invoking test-caller then Claims then Custody then Token-2022 and System -- the whole compaction composition the route exists for.

bindings.label: fractional claim-check: a worthless coordinate compacts and mints no record
bindings.note: The zero-value boundary of the same route: a coordinate worth nothing compacts, mints no claim-check record, and never moves the burn authority. Observed once, accepted, test-caller then Claims.

bindings.label: fractional claim-check: the holder redeems shards for collateral
bindings.note: DCLTFCR1. The sleeping holder wakes and redeems; observed 4 times, accepted, Claims plus two Token-2022 invocations.

bindings.label: fractional claim-check: redemption refuses: substituted payout owner
fractional claim-check: redemption refuses: substituted shard authority
bindings.note: HOSTILE, and a different substitution from the row above reaching the same code. Observed twice as Custom(0x5661).

bindings.label: fractional claim-check: redemption refuses: holder overdraw
bindings.note: HOSTILE. A holder redeeming more than they hold refuses on conservation. Observed twice as Custom(0x5663).

bindings.label: fractional claim-check: redemption refuses: sub-denominator dust
bindings.note: HOSTILE. Shards below the denominator buy no whole claim. Observed twice as Custom(0x5665).

bindings.label: fractional claim-check: create the custody replay
bindings.note: Campaign setup rather than a new route: DCLCCR01 is already witnessed by claims-rational-representation-v2. Bound because it is a real transaction this campaign submits and the census should not have to guess which of its 47 are load-bearing.

bindings.label: fractional claim-check: crank refuses Faithful/None
bindings.note: HOSTILE. A faithful market, and only the crank authority substituted. Observed once as Custom(0x5641).

bindings.label: fractional claim-check: crank refuses Faithful/CoreMarketBeforeTerminal
bindings.note: HOSTILE, and the one worth reading. The Core Market is rewritten to `Open` with its terminal receipt dropped, at its own derived address, so the phase is the SOLE discriminator. This raises `Phase` (0x5644) -- a code that could not be raised at all until 2026-09-01: it was declared for exactly this check and the fractional route never made it, which lane S11 convicted as a missing guard (`docs/evidence/DEBT_OWNERSHIP_LEDGER_2026_09_01.md` 1.3) and S7 then landed at `fractional_claim_check_v1.rs:1196-1209`. This observation is the first census evidence of that guard firing on a real ELF. Observed once as Custom(0x5644).
